comment: Written once, here, for every metal including the uranium mod's - a pattern for a metal that does not exist simply never matches, so this needs no mod guard and no second writer. compatability/uraniumexpanded-endgame-anvils.json deliberately does NOT touch these maps: two files writing one map made the result depend on which applied first, which is what broke on the testbed. The '*' fallback stays LAST or the patterns above it never match.
